deviations.what: the original binds infoState via the presentation-only formatter '.formatter.status' (maps the already-classified Status Available->Success / Out of Stock->Warning / Discontinued->Error / else None to a ValueState). abap2UI5 being a thin frontend, the info state is derived in the backend into the INFOSTATE field and bound directly (infoState="{INFOSTATE}"); same output, no loss. All 123 mock rows (Name/Status) kept verbatim; the List items sorter:{path:'NAME'} is kept 1:1 as a raw binding-info string.
